description: Find issues in Yandex Tracker. Pass exactly ONE search parameter: "queue" (queue key), "keys" (list of issue keys), "filter" (field->value object), "query" (Tracker query language string, e.g. "Queue: TREK Assignee: me()"), "query2" (query language 2.0 object) or "filterId" (saved filter id). Supports pagination via perPage/page.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of issue fields to include in the response

filter.description: Filter object: field name -> value, e.g. {"queue": "TREK", "assignee": "user1"}

keys.description: Issue key or list of issue keys

perScroll.description: Max issues per scroll page (default 100, max 1000)

query.description: Query in Tracker query language, e.g. 'Queue: TREK Resolution: empty()'

scrollId.description: Scroll page id from the previous response

scrollType.description: Enable result scrolling for large sets: "sorted" keeps the order, "unsorted" is cheaper. First request only.

name: find_issues
